official_title: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (AR6): Climate Change 2021 – The Physical Science Basis (Summary for Policymakers)
issuing_organization: Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC / WMO / UNEP)
license_or_access: Open Access / Official UN Scientific Publication
description: Authentic headline statements and findings on 1.1°C observed warming, radiative forcing by CO2 and methane, extreme weather events, ocean warming, and net-zero mitigation requirements.

official_title: The Paris Agreement: Authentic Treaty Text under the UNFCCC
issuing_organization: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)
license_or_access: Public Domain / United Nations Treaty Collection
description: Official treaty articles detailing global temperature limits (well below 2.0°C and pursuing 1.5°C), Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), carbon market mechanisms (Article 6), and adaptation framework (Article 7).

official_title: UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2023: The Broken Record – Temperatures hit new highs
license_or_access: Open Access / Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY 4.0)
description: Official findings on record global greenhouse gas emissions of 57.4 GtCO2e, emissions gap between current policies and Paris goals, and priority mitigation pathways.

official_title: National Innovations in Climate Resilient Agriculture (NICRA): Technology Demonstration and Impact Assessment
issuing_organization: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
license_or_access: Government of India Open Data / Official Research Monograph
description: Authentic agricultural adaptation research documenting drought-resilient crop varieties (CR Dhan 801, DRR 42), drip irrigation water savings (40-60%), rainwater harvesting structures, and custom hiring centers.

official_title: National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC) & Long-Term Low-Emission Development Strategy (LT-LEDS)
issuing_organization: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), Government of India
description: Official Indian climate policy documentation detailing the 8 National Missions, including the National Solar Mission, National Water Mission, National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture, and 500 GW non-fossil target.

official_title: NASA Global Climate Vital Signs and NOAA Global Monitoring Observations
issuing_organization: National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) & National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)
description: Empirical observation records of atmospheric CO2 (421+ ppm at Mauna Loa), satellite radar altimetry sea level rise (3.4 mm/year), ocean heat content, and ice sheet mass losses.

official_title: WMO State of the Global Climate 2023 (WMO-No. 1347)
description: Global climate analysis on warmest calendar year on record (1.45°C above pre-industrial levels), widespread marine heatwaves, Antarctic sea ice extent minimums, and early warning systems for extreme weather.

official_title: Amazon Tipping Point, Deforestation and Forest Carbon Dynamics
issuing_organization: Science Advances / Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (INPE Brazil)
description: Deforestation impacts in the Amazon Basin, evapotranspiration moisture recycling degradation, transition of tropical forests to net carbon sources, and critical mitigation through afforestation and protected indigenous territories.
